description:
Schedule content for future publishing. Same media rules as publish_content apply.

• mediaUrl must be a public HTTPS URL — call create_upload_session if user shares a file in chat.
• Content is validated at schedule time, not publish time.

bypassToken.description: Optional forward-compatible bypass token returned by advanced scheduling score-gate checks.

boardId.description: Pinterest only: Board ID to pin to. If not specified, uses first available board.

boardName.description: Pinterest only: Board name (alternative to boardId). Searches for matching board.

facebookMode.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for Facebook mode. Preferred: content.platformSettings.facebook.facebookMode

firstComment.description: Instagram first comment text (often used for hashtags)

link.description: Pinterest source URL for the pin

mediaType.description: Media type hint: 'image' for photos, 'video' for Reels/TikTok

mediaUrl.description: Public HTTPS media URL. Do NOT pass local file paths — use create_upload_session to get a public URL first.

mediaUrls.description: Carousel: Instagram (2-10 images), Threads (2-20 mixed), X (2-4 images)

pinterestBoardId.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for Pinterest board targeting. Preferred: content.platformSettings.pinterest.boardId

platformSettings.description: Optional advanced per-platform settings map. Key by platform ID and use it for platform-specific publish options plus per-platform text/title/description overrides.

privacyStatus.description: YouTube video privacy: public, unlisted, or private

text.description: Post caption/text. Required for all platforms.

threadTweets.description: X (Twitter) only: additional tweets in the thread after the main text. The main text is always the first tweet. Each item here becomes a subsequent reply in the thread.

mediaUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS image or video URL for this tweet

mediaUrls.description: Optional multiple images for this tweet (max 4)

title.description: YouTube video title, Pinterest pin title

youtubeMode.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for YouTube mode. Preferred: content.platformSettings.youtube.youtubeMode

mediaAttachments.description: Optional forward-compatible media asset attachments to associate with the scheduled post.

platformOverrides.description: Optional forward-compatible per-platform overrides keyed by platform ID.

platforms.description: Target platforms - ensure content matches each platform's requirements

recurrenceEndDate.description: Optional forward-compatible ISO 8601 end date for recurrence.

recurrenceRule.description: Optional forward-compatible RRULE string for recurring schedules.

scheduleMode.description: Optional forward-compatible scheduling mode. 'queue' asks SendIt to place the post in the next available queue slot.

scoreGate.description: Optional forward-compatible minimum content score threshold for advanced scheduling flows.

targetAccounts.description: Optional advanced scheduling target account IDs. Legacy handlers may ignore this until advanced scheduling is enabled.

team_id.description: Team ID to schedule as team. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, schedules from personal accounts.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for queue scheduling and recurring series metadata.

name: schedule_content
title: Schedule Content
